items.title: Harry "Chicken" Oscar Interview, 1959-07-11
items.q: Frankie Dooson and I were the first two trombones in the band.

ctx.x: Do you remember any other trombonists? Dooson you say?
Frankie Dooson and I were the first two trombones in the band.
Was Carnish in there? Do you remember? No, no. Bill Carnish never did get in the band.
